sifCedsStandardPlugin.namedMover: THE IDS MOVED, AND THE CAUSE IS SINGULAR AND NAMED: the BS-7 rebase of b4-sif-plugin from base 3e5357f to 55357b5, taken so B4 would INHERIT 1393f82 (BR-067 purpose-satisfied + symmetric-contrast re-ask + named refusal net — the fix without which the Ed-Fi D4 real run died at subject 50 of 701) and c64d6d3 (DR-2, the SSSOM exporter emitting subject_match_field by disposition). frameworkFingerprint moved 45e93f4cf430… -> ad3cc4c77532…, and the decision block, the relationship block and the manifest moved with it because each is content-addressed over a text that carries the fingerprint. WHAT DID NOT MOVE, asserted BEFORE the re-run rather than observed after it: the cardinalityCensus (2,231 / 1,875 / 327 / 29 / 0 / 0, member for member), the contentionCensus, the three digests, the source channel digest, the walk (15,620 / 2,231 / 13,389 / 0) and the edge and SSSOM row counts (2,070 each). The classifier reads the source walk, the hub cards and the declared tables; the judge contract touches none of them, so a judge-side fix cannot legitimately shift a classifier count — and a census that HAD moved would have been a DEFECT rather than a re-key. Both halves had to happen in opposite directions for this to be a good result: if the ids had NOT moved, the fingerprint would not actually cover the files that changed and "zero framework change" would be unprovable by content address.
